objective: Decide which Prosperity/Phi comparison grains are valid and map them to admissible local M143/M147/M154, ATLIF and RQTB claims without modifying production or docs/359.

verdict.headline_choice_now: standalone module evidence plus same-clock heldout opportunity
verdict.best_safe_performance_statement: M147 is a 1.805434x same-clock heldout recurrence opportunity over M143 B4 on four H67/Motion Conv3x3 layers; M154 independently verifies the four-vector supplier interface and logic-only 3-ns timing, but does not admit that ratio.
verdict.reason: The cycle opportunity is not yet an integrated RTL-calibrated path and excludes priced SRAM, weight loading, accumulator/writeback, address-timed DRAM, matched resources, power and Local5 generalization.

external_metric_decisions.why: VGG-16/CIFAR100 throughput table at common 500 MHz and 28 nm versus dense Eyeriss; PE count is not equal.
The simulator comparison is not uniformly full-network: PTB/SATO/MINT transformer rows cover linear layers only.
It compares product-sparsity Prosperity with bit-sparsity-only Prosperity, not an independent full system.
The paper explicitly measures end-to-end transformer inference on A100, but compares that measured GPU with a modeled/synthesized ASIC.
The paper labels these dense and bit-sparse comparisons theoretical.
VGG16/CIFAR100 table at common 500 MHz and 28 nm versus dense Eyeriss.
The evaluated-model aggregate is the strongest relevant hardware-level Phi comparison, but the paper does not establish attention/layer-normalization coverage or call it end-to-end.
It is the delta from Phi without PAFT and the paper reports a minor accuracy decrease.

local_claim_decisions.admitted: 20-record H67/Motion heldout same-clock recurrence: 135461009 B4 cycles, 2.594690x versus compact256 and 1.812226x versus dualrow512.
local_claim_decisions.prosperity_phi_analogy: Closest to a DSE/algorithm recurrence, below their accelerator simulator evidence.

local_claim_decisions.admitted: Same heldout recurrence opportunity: 75029590 ideal cycles and 1.805434x versus M143 B4; the older compact256/dualrow ratios are bundled-baseline numbers and secondary only.
local_claim_decisions.attack: Without same-destination combining the recurrence is 137150654 cycles, only 0.987680x versus M143; 75.9509% of descriptors repeat a destination.
local_claim_decisions.prosperity_phi_analogy: Could become a Phi/Prosperity-style accelerator-simulator result only after G2-G5; today it is closer to their theoretical/DSE ablations.

local_claim_decisions.admitted: Standalone commercial VCS/SVA passes 55 descriptors, 208 independent vector groups, 19968 lane checks, 40 II=1 pairs and three protocol attacks; logic-only DC at 3 ns reports 13282.668059 um2 with +1.6514/+0.0002 ns setup/hold slack.
local_claim_decisions.grain: standalone RTL function plus pre-macro logic-only synthesis
local_claim_decisions.prosperity_phi_analogy: A component proof, not comparable to their accelerator throughput tables.

local_claim_decisions.admitted: Standalone exact-SHA 3-ns TSMC28HPC+ logic-only RTL/DC/STA/Formality: 63114.407654 um2, +0.4173/+0.0104 ns setup/hold slack, zero mapped multipliers, 5276 passing and zero failing compare points.
local_claim_decisions.prosperity_phi_analogy: Comparable only to a component-level synthesis row, not their total area/power or performance.

local_claim_decisions.admitted: RTL-calibrated attention-core model changes 3656069 to 3090731 cycles, 1.182914x; substituting it into the current activity-weighted 620302905-cycle envelope gives a modeled 1.000911x ratio.
local_claim_decisions.grain: kernel cycle model and non-measured full-envelope sensitivity
not_admitted: multiplication with M147 or ATLIF ratios
local_claim_decisions.prosperity_phi_analogy: The 1.182914x is an incremental kernel ablation; the 1.000911x is an Amdahl sensitivity, not an end-to-end result.

p0.finding: No one artifact connects raw signed tuples through M147 packing, M154 four-vector supply, same-destination combining, four-bank accumulation/writeback and ordered barriers under measured backpressure.
p0.impact: The 1.805434x opportunity cannot be promoted to accelerator or hardware speedup.

p0.finding: There is no same-resource cycle simulator with priced SRAM/DRAM and power for Fixed, bit sparse, M143, M147/M154, Prosperity and Phi-like cases.
p0.impact: No fair counterpart to Prosperity/Phi accelerator throughput, energy, area-efficiency or ablation tables exists.

p1.finding: M143/M147 evidence covers H67/Motion ep35 heldout records and four Conv3x3 layers; Local5 and broader sequence/density strata are absent.
M154 VCS/DC receipts pass, but producer contracts remain READY and this audit found no independent M154 hammer/promotion receipt.
p1.repair_gate: Promote exact receipt identity only after a separate attack review; retain exclusions.

p1.finding: M147, ATLIF and RQTB use different operators, baselines, calibration levels and memory assumptions.
p1.repair_gate: G3; combine only as absolute cycles in a common schedule, never by multiplying local speedups.

p1.finding: No address-timed SRAM/DRAM transactions, CACTI/macro replacements, SAIF or PTPX energy are bound to the performance recurrence.
No official Phi simulator repository was identified; a local Phi adapter would be clean-room, and PAFT requires an explicit train-only protocol plus exact accuracy deltas.
Prosperity PTB/SATO/MINT transformer comparisons are linear-layer-only, while Phi does not prove attention/layer-normalization end-to-end coverage.
p1.repair_gate: Every baseline row must state supported operators and excluded work; unmatched rows may not enter a geomean.

p2.finding: Prosperity/Phi tables use 500 MHz; local M154/ATLIF evidence is a 3-ns constraint (333.333 MHz nominal), not measured Fmax.
p2.repair_gate: Report absolute cycles and time at each admitted clock; frequency-normalize only with explicit assumptions.

p2.finding: External GOP/s treats one sparse accumulation/addition as an operation; local source events, products, descriptors and commits are not interchangeable OP units.
p2.repair_gate: Freeze one OP definition, INT8 precision, and MAC-versus-add convention.

p2.finding: External papers report aggregates plus individual workloads; a local maximum on four layers or one sample is insufficient.
p2.repair_gate: Report every workload, arithmetic/geometric mean where valid, p50/p95, and worst case.

minimum_required_tables.purpose: Prevents theoretical, local and end-to-end numbers from sharing one speedup column.
Makes equal-resource and synthesis/model boundaries visible.
Supplies the evidence behind any aggregate and exposes limited layer/sample extent.
Shows where the speedup comes from and prices the mechanism that creates it.

august_31_evidence_gates.pass: Primary claim is explicitly accelerator-module, accelerator-model or end-to-end; INT8 OP/add/MAC definition and baseline are frozen.
Frozen Motion and Local5 ordered signed traces, disjoint train/calibration/test identities, checkpoint accuracy, sequence/density strata and exact PAFT/non-PAFT accuracy ledger exist.

One exact-SHA RTL boundary covers packer, signed metadata, M154 four-vector supply, combine, accumulator/writeback and barriers; VCS/SVA plus Formality pass directed, random backpressure and stale/reorder attacks.
Cycle simulator charges measured RTL latency, finite buffers, loading, stalls, barriers and accumulator commits; ordered trace replay matches RTL receipts.
Target SRAM macro or CACTI geometry/ports are priced, address-timed DRAMsim3 runs complete, and DC/STA/SAIF/PTPX produces separated logic/SRAM/DRAM area and energy.

Fixed, bit sparse, M143 and M147/M154 use identical resources; Prosperity uses official repository commit 6ee1c6f... through an explicit adapter; Phi-like is labeled clean-room; borrowed paper ratios are never substituted for local results.
T1-T4 contain absolute metrics, all individual workloads and valid aggregates; an independent hammer rejects scope, memory, baseline and accuracy attacks before any ratio is promoted.

deadline_decision_rule: If G1-G5 are not all closed by 2026-08-31, report standalone M154/ATLIF evidence and M143/M147/RQTB opportunity/sensitivity only. Do not claim 2x accelerator, full-network or system speedup.
